title: Diocese forces ‘gay priest’ known for ‘Pride Mass’ to retire
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — Fr. Fred Daley, the 79-year-old pastor at All Saints Catholic Church in Syracuse, New York, who identifies as gay, is being forced to retire by Bishop Douglas Lucia. In recent years, Daley has come to national attention for affirming LGBTQ+ parishioners, flying a pride flag in the church sanctuary, and permitting leftist politician Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, better known as AOC, to speak from the sanctuary. … “Father Fred has been called into the bishop’s office several times in the last few years – because he didn’t say Mass according to what they think, or because of our LGBTQ pride activities, or for opening the church to an event with AOC,” Dale Avers, a member of All Saints’ parish council, told The Central Current . Jeff Wright, a co-chair of All Saints’ LGBTQ+ Task Force, told The Central Current , “I personally strongly condemn the forced retirement of Father Fred and call on Bishop Lucia to explain fully and publicly what changed, why it changed and why the people most directly affected by this decision had so little voice in it.” Bishop Lucia announced that Daley would be replaced by Fr. John Manno, 51.

title: Papal Posse’s Fr. Gerald Murray joins John-Henry to speak on Francis and Leo XIV
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. Father Gerald Murray joins John-Henry Westen to examine the growing confusion within the Catholic Church under Pope Francis and the challenges facing Pope Leo. Drawing on his expertise as a canon lawyer and his book The Papacy of Confusion , Fr. Murray argues that Pope Francis repeatedly disregarded established canon law, creating uncertainty around fundamental Catholic teachings. He highlights controversies involving Communion for divorced and civilly remarried Catholics, blessings for same-sex … Meet the priest who left the diocese to join the SSPX despite the excommunication Priest: Leo won’t do Pachamama in Peru. He’ll let others do it Here is What the Triumph of the Immaculate Heart will Look Like

title: Carney downplays China threat before visit, says US a greater security risk
description: OTTAWA ( LifeSiteNews ) — Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney will make a second trip to China this year even though former intelligence staff have warned about potential data breaches of Canadians at the hands of the communist regime. Right before his trip, Carney shockingly made a comment suggesting that Canada’s economic ties to China pose less of a threat than the current administration of the United States. … Earlier this year, former U.S. CIA director Mike Pompeo warned that Canada has become deeply infiltrated by agents of Communist China. The EV deal has been blasted as being bad for Canada. Indeed, a former Canadian intelligence officer directly warned Canadian MPs that Chinese cars, notably electric ones, pose a risk to the nation’s electrical grid and are a direct surveillance threat. LifeSiteNews also reported on an exposé saying that Carney and former Prime Minister Justin Trudeau are influenced by an “elite network” of foreign actors, including those with ties to China and the World Economic Forum.
